notes.text: Red and Blue stand in a dark hallway holding flashlights. Red points toward two separate corridors.
Blue folds her arms and gives Red a flat, unimpressed look.
Red shrugs and heads for the basement stairs, waving Blue toward the kitchen.
Blue crosses the kitchen and turns the deadbolt on the back door, checking the handle twice.
Red freezes on the stairs and looks up at the ceiling as dust falls.
Blue flips every light switch on and edges back toward the front door, motioning Red to follow.
Red turns away from Blue and climbs toward the upstairs landing; Blue reaches after him.
